items.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for High‑Frequency Portfolio Optimization
items.core_idea: Uses Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) to optimize HFT portfolios under transaction costs and market impact.
items.methodology: Multi‑agent RL with continuous action spaces, trained on limit‑order‑book data.
items.quant_impact: Reduces slippage by 18% in backtests on NASDAQ equities.

items.title: Neural Stochastic Volatility Models with Jump Diffusion
items.core_idea: Combines neural ODEs with jump‑diffusion processes for volatility forecasting.
items.methodology: Variational autoencoder structure with Bayesian latent variables.
items.quant_impact: Improves VIX prediction accuracy by 22% versus GARCH‑family models.

items.title: Quantum Algorithms for Portfolio Optimization Show Promise
items.core_idea: Early quantum computing experiments demonstrate speedup for mean‑variance optimization.
items.methodology: Gate‑based quantum circuits on IBM‑Q hardware.
items.quant_impact: Potential for real‑time rebalancing of large portfolios once quantum hardware matures.

items.title: Qlib‑RL
items.description: Reinforcement learning toolkit for quantitative finance built on Qlib.
items.core_idea: Open‑source platform for training RL agents on financial data.
items.quant_impact: Lowers barrier to entry for RL‑based trading strategies.

items.title: Basel IV Impact on Internal Model Approvals
items.core_idea: New Basel IV rules will require more conservative capital calculations for trading books.
items.methodology: Regulatory analysis based on BCBS consultation papers.
items.quant_impact: Banks may need to revise VaR, ES, and stress‑testing models.
